assessment: Timing and observed customer success miss targets; missing-part reports warrant verification. Mixed batches and short-partition confusion suggest opportunities without establishing causes. Require 59/60 complete orders, median time at most eight minutes, and 90% unaided arrangement success within every constraint. Neither hypothesis demonstrates these outcomes.

openings.claim: A reusable order-specific kitting board with one outlined position per required partition could expose omissions and layout-switch errors before insertion.
openings.delta: Turn the ordered arrangement into a physical empty-position checklist; transfer its complete kit together instead of repeatedly consulting shared shape bins.
openings.prediction: Matched mixed-layout sequences show fewer verified picking errors and less selection/checking time, with little insertion-time change. No improvement weakens the selection-switching explanation.
openings.probe: Make reusable spare-board outlines for accepted layouts with an exterior-color field. Both workers alternate methods on matched mixed sequences. Independently verify contents and separately time selection, insertion, checking and packing. Include preparation/reset labor; reject designs exceeding the shared budget or delivery date.
assumptions: Parts have distinguishable outlines or labels.
Boards fit the bench and can be prepared within remaining delivery time.

openings.claim: For layouts using a short partition, shipping it already seated in its ordered position could provide an assembly reference while the remaining partitions ship loose.
openings.delta: Retain one potentially informative assembly step; test whether its spatial cue removes ambiguity while saving other workshop insertion work.
openings.prediction: Customers place remaining parts unaided despite reduced workshop assembly; short-partition questions decrease. Dislodgement or increased confusion would undermine the benefit.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent and partial assemblies with ten participants, counterbalancing exposure across different layouts. Record first-exposure success separately, partition questions, dislodgement after ordinary packed handling, and total workshop time. Verify exact components, color, footprint and assortment capacity. Treat results as screening; proceed only within combined 500 initial and 0.40 recurring limits and the fixed date.
assumptions: The short partition stays seated without permanent bonding or extra structural parts.
Loose parts can be secured within the material allowance.
